description: agent-fabric's rules for runtime/github/arm.sh: which changes are its security boundary, so that a pull request of fewer than eight work commits touching one is armed only on the owner's word and one of eight or more is named as a boundary change in its basis. boundary.paths: the fence and every guard (policies/, tools/fabric/guards/, runtime/claude-code/hooks/ and the settings that register them), what may change what (policies/authority.json, identities/keys/), the secret stores and every tool that reads, writes or runs with a secret (tools/fabric/secretstore/, secret_store.py, secrets_sync.py, secret_run.py, store_*.py, accounts), the control plane's signing and actions (runtime/control/), provisioning, which runs as root on every host (runtime/provisioning/, new_agent*.py, python_pin.py), the launcher, which composes every session's environment (tools/fabric/launch.py, runtime/openrouter/), the GitHub layer's repository resolution (tools/fabric/gh.py), the routing that picks the review model (routing/policies/), CI (.github/), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, token, credential, key, sign, trust, auth, guard). boundary.exempt is dropped first: Markdown prose under docs/ and memory/, and a locale's translations. No classes. waiver_role is null: in agent-fabric only the owner waives the boundary, by arming it themselves.
